title: 19UZ8026Q0018 Power Generators maintenance services for the U.S. Embassy Tashkent.
agency: STATE, DEPARTMENT OF.STATE, DEPARTMENT OF.US EMBASSY TASHKENT
description_text: The full solicitation is available on the U.S. Embassy Tashkent local website at https://uz.usembassy.gov/procurement-and-contracting/ Interested vendors must download the solicitation from the local website and submit quotations electronically via email to: TashkentGSOProcurement@state.gov The solicitation will remain open until June 08, 2026. No paper submissions will be accepted.
